mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation and increases risk appetite, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.5% within 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages indicates strong underlying demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST are both above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO growth below 1.0% annually), supply constraints and inflationary pressures reduce corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% and INDPRO < 12mo MA, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals the Federal Reserve may initiate monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (characterized by low unemployment and low inflation), a simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST are both above their 12-month moving averages during an early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average and a rise in annualized inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals stagflationary pressures, which reduce corporate profit margins and increase risk aversion, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12mo MA and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 12mo MA and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
